description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Subscription' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Sale' namespace. It manages sales subscriptions, providing methods for listing, filtering, and viewing subscription details in the admin panel of Opencart. The class extends a base Controller class and handles HTTP request parameters to generate filtered lists of subscriptions, as well as rendering the respective views.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale subscriptions in the admin panel, including listing, filtering, and viewing subscription details.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale subscriptions in the admin panel, including listing, filtering, viewing details, and handling history and status updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method which loads the subscription list page, sets the page title, and passes filtered data to the view for rendering.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to list all subscriptions, invoking getList to generate the HTML content for the list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of subscriptions based on current filter parameters, retrieves subscription data from the model, and formats it for display.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific subscription, including associated order, customer, and subscription plan details.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to save or update a subscription, including changing subscription plan and status, and adding history entries.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of actions and status changes for a specific subscription.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Fetches the paginated list of history entries for a subscription and returns as a string.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history entry for a subscription, including status update and comments.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Sets the response output to the order details related to a subscription.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order details associated with a subscription.
